warnings: CORRECTED 2026-08-24 — this sheet is what settled the outer 1.50m offset for the whole house. All three member descriptions here originally anchored themselves to 'ring beam RB1', written while RB1 was believed to be an 11.00m x 11.00m ring 1.50m outside the columns. Makham's ruling on หน้า27 is that RB1 sits ON the 8x8 column grid. What actually occupies the 1.50m offset is THIS sheet's roof frame: its solid outline runs 1.50m outside the grid on all four sides and carries เชิงชายเหล็ก (โดยรอบ). So dummy grids 1'/3'/A'/C' are real, just roof-frame lines rather than ring-beam lines. Descriptions rewritten accordingly and grid_refs added to the fascia.

This is a STRUCTURAL roof framing plan (steel rafters/purlins/hip rafters with real member callouts over the ring beam) — recorded as pattern 'plan' per the roof_plan-vs-plan rule (a structural roof-framing plan is 'plan', not 'roof_plan'), NOT skipped.

Members here repeat typically across the whole roof (rafters @1.00m, purlins @0.50m) rather than sitting at individually-marked grid positions, so grid_ref is omitted on these entries and spacing_mm + a descriptive extent is used instead, matching §6a's spacing-based repeated-member convention.

'purlin' and 'fascia' have no dedicated element_type in the established §0.4 vocabulary — used 'steel_member' (an existing value) for both rather than inventing new ones, with the specific role recorded in each element's note field.

No dimension/size is printed for the purlin profile itself (แปเหล็กสำเร็จรูป) — only its spacing (@0.50ม) is given; recorded as spacing_mm=500 with no steel_section (member profile genuinely not specified on this sheet).

pattern re-labelled 'etc_plan' -> 'roof_frame_plan' on 2026-08-28, closing the schema section-1 plan-family split (the split created beam_plan/footing_plan/roof_frame_plan but every legacy file had been bulk-renamed to etc_plan, which section 1 defines as the residual 'not a beam plan, not a footing plan, not a roof-framing plan'). Decided from what the sheet DRAWS -- discipline plus the element_type mix, with the view's own title as tie-breaker -- never from the filename alone. Reason: 2 roof-framing elements. Nothing else in this file changed.
